34.description: Acts done by several persons in furtherance of common intention - Each person is liable as if done by him alone

107.description: Abetment of a thing - Instigating, engaging in conspiracy, or intentionally aiding the commission of an offence

109.description: Punishment of abetment if the act abetted is committed - Same punishment as for the offence

120A.description: Criminal conspiracy - Two or more persons agree to do an illegal act or legal act by illegal means

141.description: Unlawful assembly - Assembly of five or more persons with common object to commit offence

143.description: Punishment for being member of unlawful assembly - Imprisonment up to 6 months, or fine, or both

147.description: Rioting - Use of force or violence by unlawful assembly or any member thereof

148.description: Rioting armed with deadly weapon - Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both

149.description: Every member of unlawful assembly guilty of offence committed in prosecution of common object

160.description: Committing affray - Fighting in a public place to the disturbance of public peace

166.description: Public servant disobeying law with intent to cause injury to any person

170.description: Personating a public servant - Pretending to hold office of public servant

171.description: Wearing garb or carrying token used by public servant with fraudulent intent

186.description: Obstructing public servant in discharge of public functions

191.description: Giving false evidence - Making false statement in any stage of judicial proceeding

193.description: Punishment for false evidence - Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

195A.description: Threatening or inducing any person to give false evidence

201.description: Causing disappearance of evidence of offence or giving false information to screen offender

204.description: Destruction of document or electronic record to prevent its production as evidence

211.description: False charge of offence made with intent to injure

212.description: Harbouring offender - Giving shelter to person known to be an offender

216A.description: Penalty for harbouring robbers or dacoits

224.description: Resistance or obstruction by a person to his lawful apprehension

228.description: Intentional insult or interruption to public servant sitting in judicial proceeding

268.description: Public nuisance - Act causing common injury, danger or annoyance to the public

269.description: Negligent act likely to spread infection of disease dangerous to life

270.description: Malignant act likely to spread infection of disease dangerous to life

279.description: Rash driving or riding on a public way - Endangering human life or likely to cause hurt

284.description: Negligent conduct with respect to poisonous substance

285.description: Negligent conduct with respect to fire or combustible matter

286.description: Negligent conduct with respect to explosive substance

295.description: Injuring or defiling place of worship with intent to insult the religion of any class

295A.description: Deliberate and malicious acts intended to outrage religious feelings of any class

298.description: Uttering words with deliberate intent to wound religious feelings

299.description: Culpable homicide - Causing death with intention or knowledge that act is likely to cause death

300.description: Murder - Culpable homicide is murder if done with intention of causing death or bodily injury sufficient to cause death

302.description: Punishment for murder - Death or imprisonment for life and fine

304.description: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder - Imprisonment up to 10 years with fine

304A.description: Causing death by negligence - Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both

304B.description: Dowry death - Death of woman within 7 years of marriage caused by cruelty related to dowry demand

306.description: Abetment of suicide - If any person commits suicide, whoever abets the commission shall be punished

307.description: Attempt to murder - Imprisonment up to 10 years and fine; if hurt caused, imprisonment for life

308.description: Attempt to commit culpable homicide - Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both

312.description: Causing miscarriage - Voluntarily causing a woman with child to miscarry

319.description: Hurt - Causing bodily pain, disease or infirmity to any person

320.description: Grievous hurt - Emasculation, permanent privation of sight/hearing, fracture, disfiguration etc.

321.description: Voluntarily causing hurt - Doing any act with intention or knowledge of causing hurt

323.description: Punishment for voluntarily causing hurt - Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine up to Rs. 1000, or both

324.description: Voluntarily causing hurt by dangerous weapons or means - Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both

325.description: Punishment for voluntarily causing grievous hurt - Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

326.description: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt by dangerous weapons or means - Imprisonment for life or up to 10 years and fine

326A.description: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt by use of acid - Imprisonment not less than 10 years, extendable to imprisonment for life and fine

326B.description: Voluntarily throwing or attempting to throw acid - Imprisonment not less than 5 years extendable to 7 years and fine

334.description: Voluntarily causing hurt on provocation - Imprisonment up to 1 month, or fine up to Rs. 500, or both

336.description: Act endangering life or personal safety of others - Rash or negligent act

337.description: Causing hurt by act endangering life or personal safety of others

338.description: Causing grievous hurt by act endangering life or personal safety of others

339.description: Wrongful restraint - Voluntarily obstructing a person to prevent that person from proceeding in any direction

340.description: Wrongful confinement - Wrongfully restraining a person so as to prevent that person from proceeding beyond certain circumscribing limits

341.description: Punishment for wrongful restraint - Imprisonment up to 1 month, or fine up to Rs. 500, or both

342.description: Punishment for wrongful confinement - Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine up to Rs. 1000, or both

346.description: Wrongful confinement in secret - Imprisonment up to 2 years in addition to other punishment

349.description: Force - A person is said to use force to another if he causes motion, change of motion, or cessation of motion

350.description: Criminal force - Using force intentionally to any person without that person's consent to cause injury, fear or annoyance

351.description: Assault - Making any gesture or preparation intending or knowing it to be likely to cause apprehension of criminal force

352.description: Punishment for assault or criminal force otherwise than on grave provocation - Imprisonment up to 3 months, or fine up to Rs. 500, or both

354.description: Assault or criminal force to woman with intent to outrage her modesty - Imprisonment not less than 1 year extendable to 5 years and fine

354A.description: Sexual harassment - Physical contact, demand for sexual favours, showing pornography, making sexually coloured remarks

354B.description: Assault or use of criminal force to woman with intent to disrobe - Imprisonment not less than 3 years extendable to 7 years and fine

354C.description: Voyeurism - Watching or capturing image of a woman engaging in a private act

354D.description: Stalking - Following a woman, contacting despite disinterest, monitoring use of internet/email/electronic communication

359.description: Kidnapping - Kidnapping from India or from lawful guardianship

362.description: Abduction - Compelling or inducing a person to go from any place by force or deceitful means

363.description: Punishment for kidnapping - Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

364.description: Kidnapping or abducting in order to murder - Imprisonment for life or rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years and fine

364A.description: Kidnapping for ransom - Imprisonment for life and fine; death if kidnapped person is killed

365.description: Kidnapping or abducting with intent secretly and wrongfully to confine person - Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

366.description: Kidnapping, abducting or inducing woman to compel her marriage - Imprisonment up to 10 years and fine

366A.description: Procuration of minor girl - Inducing any minor girl under 18 for illicit intercourse

370.description: Trafficking of person - Recruiting, transporting, harbouring persons by use of threats, force, coercion for exploitation

372.description: Selling minor for purposes of prostitution - Imprisonment up to 10 years and fine

375.description: Rape - Sexual intercourse with a woman against her will, without her consent, or with consent obtained by coercion

376.description: Punishment for rape - Rigorous imprisonment not less than 10 years extendable to imprisonment for life and fine

378.description: Theft - Whoever intends to take dishonestly any movable property out of the possession of any person without that person's consent

379.description: Punishment for theft - Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both

380.description: Theft in dwelling house - Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

381.description: Theft by clerk or servant of property in possession of master - Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

382.description: Theft after preparation made for causing death, hurt or restraint in order to committing of theft

383.description: Extortion - Putting any person in fear of injury and thereby dishonestly inducing the person to deliver property

384.description: Punishment for extortion - Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both

385.description: Putting person in fear of injury in order to commit extortion - Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both

390.description: Robbery - Theft or extortion is robbery if offender causes or attempts to cause death, hurt, or wrongful restraint

392.description: Punishment for robbery - Rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years and fine

393.description: Attempt to commit robbery - Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

395.description: Dacoity - Robbery committed by five or more persons conjointly

396.description: Dacoity with murder - Imprisonment for life or death and fine

397.description: Robbery or dacoity with attempt to cause death or grievous hurt - Imprisonment not less than 7 years

399.description: Making preparation to commit dacoity - Imprisonment up to 10 years and fine

403.description: Dishonest misappropriation of property - Whoever dishonestly misappropriates or converts to his own use any movable property

405.description: Criminal breach of trust - Whoever being entrusted with property dishonestly misappropriates or converts it

406.description: Punishment for criminal breach of trust - Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both

407.description: Criminal breach of trust by carrier, wharfinger or warehouse-keeper - Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

408.description: Criminal breach of trust by clerk or servant - Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

409.description: Criminal breach of trust by public servant, banker, merchant or agent - Imprisonment for life or up to 10 years and fine

411.description: Dishonestly receiving stolen property - Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both

414.description: Assisting in concealment of stolen property - Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both

415.description: Cheating - Deceiving any person and thereby dishonestly inducing the person deceived to deliver property or to do or omit to do anything

417.description: Punishment for cheating - Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine, or both

418.description: Cheating with knowledge that wrongful loss may ensue to person whose interest offender is bound to protect

419.description: Cheating by personation - Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both

420.description: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property - Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

421.description: Dishonest or fraudulent removal or concealment of property to prevent distribution among creditors

425.description: Mischief - Causing destruction or damage to property with intent to cause wrongful loss or damage

426.description: Punishment for mischief - Imprisonment up to 3 months, or fine, or both

427.description: Mischief causing damage to the amount of fifty rupees or more - Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both

429.description: Mischief by killing or maiming cattle or animal of value - Imprisonment up to 5 years, or fine, or both

430.description: Mischief by injury to works of irrigation or by wrongfully diverting water

435.description: Mischief by fire or explosive substance with intent to cause damage - Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

436.description: Mischief by fire or explosive substance with intent to destroy house - Imprisonment for life or up to 10 years and fine

441.description: Criminal trespass - Entering into or remaining upon property in possession of another with intent to commit offence or intimidate

442.description: House-trespass - Criminal trespass by entering into or remaining in any building, tent or vessel used as human dwelling

447.description: Punishment for criminal trespass - Imprisonment up to 3 months, or fine up to Rs. 500, or both

448.description: Punishment for house-trespass - Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine up to Rs. 1000, or both

449.description: House-trespass in order to commit offence punishable with death - Imprisonment for life or up to 10 years and fine

452.description: House-trespass after preparation for hurt, assault or wrongful restraint - Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

453.description: Lurking house-trespass - House-trespass by taking precautions to conceal such trespass

454.description: Lurking house-trespass in order to commit offence punishable with imprisonment - Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine

456.description: Punishment for lurking house-trespass or house-breaking by night - Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine

457.description: Lurking house-trespass or house-breaking by night in order to commit offence punishable with imprisonment - Imprisonment up to 5 years and fine

461.description: Dishonestly breaking open receptacle containing property - Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both

463.description: Forgery - Making a false document or electronic record with intent to cause damage or to support any claim

465.description: Punishment for forgery - Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both

467.description: Forgery of valuable security, will, etc. - Imprisonment for life or up to 10 years and fine

468.description: Forgery for purpose of cheating - Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

471.description: Using as genuine a forged document or electronic record

489A.description: Counterfeiting currency notes or bank notes - Imprisonment for life or up to 10 years and fine

489B.description: Using as genuine forged or counterfeit currency notes or bank notes

494.description: Marrying again during lifetime of husband or wife (Bigamy) - Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

495.description: Same offence with concealment of former marriage - Imprisonment up to 10 years and fine

497.description: Adultery - Sexual intercourse with the wife of another man without consent of that man

498.description: Enticing or taking away or detaining with criminal intent a married woman

498A.description: Husband or relative of husband of a woman subjecting her to cruelty - Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine

499.description: Defamation - Making or publishing any imputation concerning any person intending to harm reputation

500.description: Punishment for defamation - Simple imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both

503.description: Criminal intimidation - Threatening another with injury to person, reputation or property with intent to cause alarm

506.description: Punishment for criminal intimidation - Imprisonment up to 2 years, or fine, or both; if threat to cause death or grievous hurt, up to 7 years

507.description: Criminal intimidation by anonymous communication - Imprisonment up to 2 years in addition

509.description: Word, gesture or act intended to insult the modesty of a woman - Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine

510.description: Misconduct in public by a drunken person - Imprisonment up to 24 hours, or fine up to Rs. 10, or both

511.description: Punishment for attempting to commit offences punishable with imprisonment for life or other imprisonment

153A.description: Promoting enmity between different groups on grounds of religion, race, place of birth, residence, language - Imprisonment up to 3 years, or fine, or both

171E.description: Punishment for bribery at elections - Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine, or both

171F.description: Punishment for undue influence or personation at an election - Imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine, or both

376A.description: Punishment for causing death or resulting in persistent vegetative state of victim during rape - Imprisonment not less than 20 years extendable to life or death

376D.description: Gang rape - Imprisonment not less than 20 years extendable to life and fine
